citations.claim: EW yellow active at step 106, only 2s before all-red at step 108
EW yellow still active at step 107, one second before all-red
first violating step: EW yellow lasted only 2s, all-red before NS at step 108

counterfactual.change: Set actuated true->false only; fixed-time cycle restores full 4s yellow so violation disappears.

explanation: In actuated mode with long NS green (40s) vs short EW green (8s), the EW green gaps out early and the controller truncates the following EW yellow to 2s instead of the required 4s (yellow at steps 106-107, all-red at 108). Fixed-time with identical timing shows full yellow, so the bug is in actuated early-termination/recall logic cutting yellow short.
vision_note: The approaches show green in step 105, then yellow in steps 106 and 107. In step 108 all approaches are red, so the yellow lasts only two seconds before going to all-red.
